title: Ronga 2021 · Tool use and EEG
citation: Ronga et al. (2021). Seeming confines: Electrophysiological evidence of peripersonal space remapping following tool-use in humans. Cortex, 144, 133–150.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.sound: Two fixed near/far loudspeakers, less than 5 cm and 145 cm from the stimulated hand. Nominal 50 ms, 784 Hz tones.
published_method.touch: 200 µs DS7A square pulse at twice the participant’s perception threshold, to the dorsum of the right hand.
published_method.timing: Tactile event is nominal time zero for paired trials; sound starts 40 ms after it. Auditory-alone and tactile-alone trials anchor to their sole event. Publication reports randomized 7000–9000 ms ITIs.
published_method.allocation: Five conditions (T, ANear, AFar, TANear, TAFar), 24 trials each per assessment in two blocks.
published_method.visits: Two counterbalanced visits, each followed by the behavioral and EEG assessment. In one visit, participants spend 20 minutes dragging small plastic cubes with a 145 cm rake. In the other, they spend 20 minutes comparing the direction of sequential arrows 145 cm from their right hand.
published_method.analysis: Behavioral far-minus-near RT and near-minus-far ERP indices, plus time-frequency results.
published_method.recorded_schedule: The public EEG record contains 78 blocks of 60 markers and two blocks of 58 and 64 markers. Those observations do not resolve the programmed ITI, delivered onset times, or reasons for atypical counts.
published_method.source_assets: Mendeley Data 10.17632/j5t3tzfh29.1 includes five candidate stimulus WAVs and native EEG trigger records. ANear and TANear use different dominant channels. Physical channel mapping and binding to the timed stimulation controller are unresolved.

stimulus_type.source: Cortex final issue p. 136, section 2.2, and Mendeley Data v1 (10.17632/j5t3tzfh29.1), common-grid FFT on dominant audio channels of the archived WAV files.
stimulus_type.gap: All four dominant audio channels peak at 784.0 Hz on a 0.1 Hz zero-padded FFT grid. The previous approximate 800 Hz estimate is superseded. TANear and ANear use different dominant channels. Hardware routing and file binding are unverified.

value.source: Original E-Prime project/run files and five condition WAVs in author deposit.

source_provenance.source: Mendeley Data 10.17632/j5t3tzfh29.1, Study materials README and file manifest
source_provenance.gap: The visible project/run headers differ by software version. List2 also differs by experiment revision. Embedded trial lists, script-to-WAV binding and hardware output routing remain unverified.

trajectory_path.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

stimulus_duration.source: Mendeley Data 10.17632/j5t3tzfh29.1, Study materials WAVs, verified PCM inspection
stimulus_duration.gap: T is a no-tone control file. Its 100 ms file length is not the electrical pulse duration.

stimulus_speed.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

auditory_conditions.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

value.manuscript_nominal: Same source amplitude from both loudspeakers.

gain_envelope.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2.2; Mendeley Data 10.17632/j5t3tzfh29.1, Study materials WAVs, verified PCM inspection
gain_envelope.gap: TANear differs in digital amplitude and channel. Its dominant audio channel 1 reaches both PCM rails. The archived peak and amplitude do not establish delivered waveform, routing or ear-level SPL.

renderer_or_apparatus.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption; Mendeley Data 10.17632/j5t3tzfh29.1, Study materials WAVs, verified PCM inspection
renderer_or_apparatus.gap: Asset channel assignment is verified. Physical output mapping, calibration, E-Prime binding and measured latency are not.

trial_rows_families.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

condition_intermixing.value: Five conditions belong to the same multimodal paradigm.
condition_intermixing.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption
condition_intermixing.gap: Exact condition sequence and balancing within each block unspecified.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Two visits seven days apart, with counterbalanced tool-use versus visual-control order. A 20 min intervention precedes two approximately eight minute PPS blocks in each visit.
blocked_or_random_order.gap: Per-block sequence, seed and assignment schedule unavailable.

iti_jitter_policy.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption
iti_jitter_policy.gap: No distribution, steps or precise onset/offset clock specified.

task_sequence_rules.value: Complete 20 min of the visit's intervention. Then focus on right hand, ignore audio and press a key with the right index finger as quickly as possible on touch.

value.threshold_reference: twice individual detection threshold measured by method of limits before each session

tactile_stimulus.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

soa_table.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption

baseline_strategy.value: Separate T, ANear and AFar references. RT uses T and paired trials. ERP uses paired minus the sum of corresponding unimodal responses. Near-minus-far paired response compares interventions.

baseline_timing.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption
baseline_timing.gap: No sound in T trials, so no within-trial audio-relative SOA.

catch_trial_type.value: The two auditory-only conditions have no touch and are ignored.
catch_trial_type.source: Turin author manuscript, §2.2 and Fig. 1 caption
catch_trial_type.gap: These are independently analyzed sensory controls in the EEG experiments. They can function as no-go trials in detection tasks, but the manuscript does not label them dedicated catches.

baseline_count.gap: Same five-condition design after each intervention.

catch_count.gap: Two audio-only EEG reference conditions × 24 per visit, with no tactile response.

total_trial_count.gap: Five conditions × 24 per visit, twice. Training trials are separate.

implementation_gaps: Requires fixed loudspeaker routing and synchronized, individually calibrated electrical stimulation. Candidate archived tone files have unresolved output channel assignments and delivered timing.
Requires the rake or visual intervention, synchronized EEG acquisition with original marker semantics, and an operator-validated post-training visit sequencer.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
